The umbrella entrypoint runs verify_alignment_drift.py --check-router without --fail-on-warn, while that verifier itself prints 'warnings are non-blocking by default. Use --fail-on-warn to make warnings fail.' It then prints 'PASS: alignment-drift' and 'run-all-drift-guards: all 4 guards PASSED' with exit 0. Live counts: 272
PYEXIT=0 WARN lines total, 25
SKEXIT=0 under sk-code/, 25 under specs/sk-code/011. The README bills the script as 'the one drift-guard entrypoint' and documents the expected PASS lines as the success contract, so the warn-only policy of one leg is invisible in the aggregate result line.
